title: sdks: unify auth/retries/streaming ergonomics, parity fixes, v1.135.1
author: Aisha Kapoor
description: Background: this PR unifies small but important ergonomics and parity gaps across Python/TypeScript/Go SDKs: auth header handling, retry/backoff defaults, streaming iterator ergonomics, and a patch version bump to v1.135.1 to ship parity fixes. Motivation: customers reported inconsistent streaming behavior between SDKs and unexpected retry semantics when auth tokens were refreshed. This change aligns behaviors and surface area across all three SDKs. Changes include: 1) Auth: centralize token refresh hook and fallthrough header behavior (if Authorization header present, do not override; allow per-client token providers). 2) Retries: standardize default retry/backoff policy (3 attempts, exponential backoff with jitter, 250ms base). Exposed RetryPolicy type in all SDKs for custom policies. 3) Streaming: unify event iterator/api shape (async iterator in TS/Python, channel-based in Go) and provide consistent error propagation and cancelation hooks. 4) Ergonomics: small API naming updates (client.stream -> client.stream_response), improved typed responses in TypeScript, and simpler context manager semantics in Python. 5) Parity fixes: fix encoding bug in Go streaming that caused occasional truncated chunks and align multipart boundary parsing in Python. 6) Version bump: package versions set to v1.135.1 to publish parity patch. Testing and CI: added cross-SDK integration tests (mock host) and unit tests covering retry/backoff and streaming cancellation. Checklist: - [x] Design doc reviewed (ENG-2157) - [x] Unit tests added - [x] Integration tests added - [x] TypeScript types updated - [x] Docs snippet for migration notes added - [x] Changelog/release notes updated Commits: "2f4a9d1" consolidate auth hook across sdks; "5a8b1c3" standardize retry defaults + tests; "9e7b2f4" streaming ergonomics + go truncation fix; "c3d2b1a" version bumps and changelog. Files changed (high level): packages/sdk-python/src/client.py; packages/sdk-python/tests/test_streaming.py; packages/sdk-python/CHANGELOG.md; packages/sdk-typescript/src/stream.ts; packages/sdk-typescript/src/retry.ts; packages/sdk-typescript/tsconfig.json; packages/sdk-go/stream/stream.go; packages/sdk-go/retry/retry.go; packages/sdk-go/CHANGELOG.md; docs/sdk/migration/auth-retries.md; examples/streaming/parity-example.py; package.json; setup.cfg; go.mod. Notes for reviewers: focus on retry boundary conditions and streaming cancelation behavior; verify the Go buffer fix is safe under stress. Related: ENG-2163 covers monitoring additions which will follow in a separate PR.

release_notes:
- SDKs: unify auth token refresh hook and header behavior across Python/TypeScript/Go
- Standardize retry/backoff defaults (3 attempts, exponential with jitter)
- Streaming: unified iterator API and consistent cancelation/error propagation
- Fix Go streaming truncation bug and Python multipart parsing parity
- Bump SDK versions to v1.135.1 for parity fixes
